# Chapter 01 — Introduction

Grafitt is a header-only C++20 graph platform focused on production-quality APIs, diagnostics, and extensibility.

## What You Get
- Mutable and persistent graph models.
- Algorithm suite for traversal, pathfinding, ordering, decomposition, and matching.
- Rewrite and equality-saturation foundations.
- Queryfitt for structured graph querying.
- Multi-format export and GBIN serialization.
- C++ pass plugins and C ABI module extension paths.

## Design Principles
- Correctness first (directed/undirected semantics preserved).
- Strong result objects over ambiguous tuples.
- Optional integrations remain optional.
- Additive API evolution.
